photos.desc: The tadpole shrimp is an endangered animal. Found in very few places in the Maltese islands. Photo taken at Ta-Wej (Malta) over a small piece of white material in the water.
Carapax with eyes (two of an adulte Triops longicaudatus . Aquarium offspring specimen. Died after an accident. Nikon D40x with AF-S Micro NIKKOR 60 mm 1:2.8G ED.
